༄༅/ /lo dang spar me'i re'u mig gi skor dang*/rtsis kyi lde mig gi skor don bsdus gsal ba bzhugs so/ /'byung ba dang bstun pa'i ming srog lus

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lo dang spar me'i re'u mig gi skor dang*/ rtsis kyi lde mig gi skor don bsdus gsal ba bzhugs so/ /

'byung ba dang bstun pa'i ming srog lus dbang thang klung rta shing byi chu lcags shing shing shing glang sa lcags shing chu me stag shing me me lcags me yos shing me me me sa 'brug sa shing sa shing sa sbrul me shing sa chu lcags rta me sa lcags lcags lcags lug sa sa lcags me chu sprel lcags lcags chu shing chu bya lcags lcags chu chu shing khyi sa me shing lcags shing phag chu me shing me me byi chu chu me shing me glang sa chu me chu sa stag shing sa sa lcags sa yos shing sa sa me lcags 'brug sa lcags lcags shing lcags sbrul me lcags lcags chu chu rta me shing chu lcagasachu lug sa shing chu me shing sprel lcags chu shing shing shing bya lcags chu shing chu me khyi sa sa me lcags me phag chu sa me me sa byi chu me sa shing sa glang sa me sa chu lcags stag shing shing lcags lcags lcags yos shing shing lcags me chu 'brug sa chu chu shing sa sbrul me chu chu chu lo'i ming srog lus dbang thang rlung rta shing rta me lcags shing lcags shing lug sa lcags shing me me sprel lcags me me shing me bya lcags me me chu sa khyi sa shing sa lcags sa phag chu shing sa me lcags byi chu sa lcags shing lcags glang sa sa lcags chu chu stag shing lcags chu lcags chu yos shing lcags chu me shing 'brug sa me shing shing shing sbrul me me shing chu me rta me chu me lcags me lug sa chu me me sa sprel lcags sa sa shing sa bya lcags sa sa chu lcags khyi sa lcags lcags lcags lcags phag chu lcags lcags me chu byi chu shing chu chu chu glang sa shing chu chu shing stag shing chu shing lcags shing yos shing chu shing me me 'brug sa sa me shing me sbrul me sa me chu sa rta me me sa lcags sa lug sa me sa me lcags sprel lcags shing lcags shing lcags bya lcags shing lcags chu chu khyi sa chu chu lcags chu phag chu chu chu me lo'i ming sme 'breng dang po sme 'phreng gnyis pa sme 'phreng gsum pa lo'i ming sma 'phreng dang po sme 'phreng gnyis pa sme 'phreng gsum pa

/gtugs shing de nyid gnas pa'i tshul/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i klong yangs su/ /mgo bo lhor bstan mjug ma byang*/ /gzhogs g.yas shar la gzhogs g.yon nub/ /yan lag mtshams bzhir rgyangs te gnas/ /de las lo 'gros spar sme gsum/ /ji ltar chad pa'i rim pa ni/ /lus kyi shar shing lho phyogs me/ /nub lcags byang chu mtshams bzhi sa/ /shing las stag yos rnam gnyis chad/ /me las rta sbrul lcags bya sprel/ /chu las byi phag rnam gnyis dang*/ /sa las khy-i 'brug glang lug bzhi/ /gang las chad pa srog yin no/ /shar stod stag la shar smad g.yos/ /shar lho 'brug la lho stod sbrul/ /lho smad rta la lho nub lug /nub stod sprel la nub smad bya/ /nub byang khy-i la byang stod phag /byang smad byi ba byang shar glang*/ /byi stag 'brug rta sprel khyi pho/ /glang yos sbrul lug bya phag mo/ /spar kha li me khon sa dang*/ /dwa lcags khen gnam kham chu dang*/ /gin ri zin shing zon rlung ngo*/ /'on kyang phyogs kyi spar kha ni/ /phyogs bstun mtshams bzhi sa yin no/ /sme ba'i chad lugs bstan pa ni/ /gcig dkar drug dkar brgyad dkar lcags/ /gnyis nag sum thon chu yin la/ /bzhi ljang shing ste lnga ser sa/ /bdun dmar dgu dmar me yin no/ /li la gsal ba'i me long dgu /khon la gnyis de srib ri nag /lcags la rin chen 'bar ba bdun/ /nam mkha'i rgyal po drug ldan dkar/ /chu srog snying po sbu ba gcig /ri yi rgyal po rtse brgyad dkar/ /dpag bsam shing las 'bras bu thon/ /rlung gi rgyal po 'phyo ba bzhin/ /lnga ser rus sbal lto la gab/ /lo yi rim pa bstan pa ni/ /byi ba la sogs bcu gnyis te/ /shing me sa lcags chu rim bzhin/ /lnga lngar ldan pas drug cur 'gyur/ /de la sme ba'ang drug cu ste/ /drug cu skor zhes grags pa yin/ /lo yi thog ma byi ba dang*/ /zla ba'i thog ma stag yin no/ /zla ba pho drug stag gis tshes/ /mo drug sprel tshes khy-i 'brug nya/

/glang lug gnyis ni stong la 'char/ /dus tshod nam langs yos yin la/ /nyi shar 'brug la nyi dros sbrul/ /nyi phyed rta la phyed yol lug /myur kha sprel la nyi nub bya/ /sa sros khyi la srod 'khor phag /nam phyed byi ba phyed yol glang*/ /tho rangs stag gi dus su brtsi/ /gnam lo ma la zla ba bu/ /da lta'i rab nyi me yos kyi/ /dpyid zla rab 'bring sa yi khams/ /dpyid tha dbyar ra lcags khams so/ /rim par khams res zla ba gnyis/ /bu 'ded byas pas mi nor 'grub/ /zla ba ma la zhag ni bu/ /dpyid zla ra ba sa pho stag /tshes gcig lcags pho stag yin la/ /tshes gnyis lcags mo yos su 'dod/ /de ltar rim par brtsis pas 'grub/ /sme ba drug cu tshan gsum la/ /brgya dang brgyad cu tham pa 'byung*/ /brgyad cu skor zhes grags pa yin/ /pho brang dang po gcig 'byung ste/ /gcig gi tha ma lnga ru zad/ /lnga zad tha ma bzhi la 'drongs/ /bzhi yi tha ma brgyad du zad/ / brgyad zad tha ma bdun la 'drongs/ /bdun gyi tha ma gnyis su zad/ /gnyis zad tha ma gcig la 'drongs/ /'khor zhing 'khor ba ma gtogs pa/ /lhag cing chad pa yongs mi srid/ /shing pho byi ba'i bzhi ljang nas/ /chu mo phag gi brgyad dkar bar/ /dgra zun gnyis gnyis sme ba gcig /sa pho byi nas sa phag bar/ /lo 'gros dbus ma ma gtogs pa/ /shing byi me stag la sogs pa'i/ /dbang thang ma bu rim gyis 'khor/ /de ltar lo 'gros re re la/ /srog lus dbang thang klung rta bzhi/ /srog ni gong ltar chad tshul yin//lus kyi lde mig bstan pa ni/ /shing byi chu sbrel lcags 'brug lcags/ / shing rta chu stag lcags khyi lcags/ /rang rang lcags nas 'byed pa ste/ /de rnams so so'i ma shing mthun/ /bu ni chu len dgra sa brkos/ /grogs ni me yi phung po 'bud/ /yang na shing gi byi glang dang*/ /shing gi rta lug chu'i stag yos/ /chu yi bya sprel lcags 'brug sbrul/ /lcags ky-i khyi phag rnams kyi lus/

/lcags yin 'di ni ma nor bar/ /ma lus shing la bu lus chu/ /dgra lus sa la grogs lus me/ /snga ma nyid dang don gcig 'gyur/ /kha srog sum cu'i lus su shes/ /shing byi me byi la sogs pa/ /'byung ba'i rang ming dbang thang yin/ /gnam lo pho lo shar ba'i tshe/ /gcig bcu rang la gnyis gsum ma/ /bzhi lnga dgra la drug bdun grogs/ /brgyad dgu bu ru shes par bya/ /gnam lo mo lo shar ba'i tshe/ /gcig gnyis rang la gsum bzhi ma/ /lnga drug dgra la bdun brgyad grogs/ /dgu bcu phu ru shes bya ste/ /pho mo lus dang dbang thang mthun/ /de nas klung rta'i ngos 'dzin ni/ /stag rta khyi gsum klung sprel lcags/ / phag lug yos gsum klung sbrul me/ /byi 'brug sprel gsum klung stag shing*/ /bya glang sbrul gsum klung phag chu/ /'byung ba sa yi klung rta med/ /rtsa ba'i lo 'gros bcu gnyis la/ /gsum tshan bzhi ru phye ba las/ /ra ba 'bṛng tha ma che chung gsum/ ra ba bzhi nas brtsi ba yin/ /klung rta mthun par sdebs pa la/ /mthun gsum zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /bzhi tshan gsum du phye ba las/ /stag dang sprai'u phag dang sbrul/ /ra ba bzhi zhes bya ba yin/ /gnyis nag lnga ser brgyad dkar gsum/ /ra ba bzhi yi skyes sme yin/ /bya dang byi ba yos bu rta/ /'bring po bzhi zhes bya ba ste/ /gcig dkar bzhi ljang bdun dmar gsum/ /'bring po bzhi yi skyes sme yin/ /glang lug khyi dang 'brug bzhi ni/ /tha chung bzhi zhes bya ba ste/ / gsum thon drug dkar dgu dmar gsum/ /tha chung bzhi yi skyes sme yin/ /gang las skyes pa'i kha dmar gdags/ /gcig pa rang keg gnyis nad 'gre / gsum pa bye bral bzhi bzhi gshed/ /lnga pa lnga mthun drug drug 'gras/ /bdun pa bdun zur dag tu shes/ /kha yan la sogs bshad pa ni/ /srog dang dbang thang gcig pa la/ /kha yan lo zhes bshad pa ste/ /dper mtshon shing gi stag yos bzhin/ /dbang thang srog gi bu ro song*/

/se zhig ces ni bshad pa ste/ /dper na me yi stag yos bzhin/ /dbang thang srog gi ma ru song*/ /khong nong lo zhes bya ba ste/ /dper na chu yi stag yos bzhin/ /dbang thang srog gi grogs su song*/ /kha ral lo zhes bya ba ste/ /dper na sa yi stag yos bzhin/ /dbang thang srog gi dgra ru song*/ / bdun khur zhes ni bshad pa ste/ /dper na lcags kyi stag yos bzhin/ /lo skor drug cu tham pa la/ /kha yan lo ni bcu gnyis te/ /de bzhin se zhig khong nong dang*/ /kha ral bdun khur rnams la yang*/ /lo ni bcu gnyis bcu gnyis yod/ /spyi ni gnam lo pho mo gnyis/ /pho lo drug shar mo lo zur/ /mo lo drug shar pho lo zur/ /dper na stag dang yos bzhin no/ /khams lnga'i brtsi lugs bstan pa ni/ /keg shing ji me kung sa dang*/ / bshang lcags 'u chu lnga ru 'dus/ /rus khams gang dang mthun par sbyar/ /'u dang sbyar ba'i chu khams la/ /byi phag byung na dbang lo yin/ /'brug byung chad chen gtso bo lo/ /khyi ni che chung sna ma'i lo/ /byang sprail gnyis ni ma lo yin/ /stag yos gnyis ni bu lo yin/ /rta sbrul gnyis ni grogs lo yin/ /glang lug gnyis ni dgra lo yin/ /rus chen lhag ma bzhi po yang*/ /de yi rigs 'gre shes par bya/ /me dur khyi la lcags dur glang*/ /shing du ra lug las dur 'brug /tha chung bzhi la dur zhes bya/ /dur zhugs gang yin chad chen dang*/ /de yi bdun zur chad chung yin/ /srog lus dbang sogs bzhi po yang*/ /lcags dpyid me dgun shing ston dang*/ /sa chu gnyis po dbyar nas brtsi/ /ra ba bzhi nas brtsi ba yin/ /ra ba 'bris po tha chung gsum/ /dpyid dang dbyar dang ston dang mthun/ /kun la gsum gsum sbyar ste/ /bcu gnyis dag tu shes par bya/ / dbugs len mngal gnas lus rdzog dang*/ /btsas dang khrus byed gos gyon dang*/ /las byed dar ba gud pa dang*/ /na ba shi ba dur zhugs te/ /dar gud rnam pa bcu gnyis so/

/dbugs len nas bzungabartsis pa na/ /gnam lo'i steng sleb lo yin la/ /zla ba'i steng sleb zla ba dang*/ /zhag dang zla ba'ang de bzhin no/ /ma bu dgra grogs brtsi tshul ni/ /shing ma chu la shing bu me/ /shing dgra lcags la shing grogs sa/ /me ma shing la me bu sa/ /me dgra chu la me grogs lcags/ /sa ma me la sa bu lcags/ /sa dgra shing la sa grogs chu/ /lcags ma sa la lcags bu chu/ /lcags dgra me la lcags grogs shing*/ /chu ma lcags la chu bu shing*/ /chu dgra sa la chu grogs me/ /g.yas su skor bas ma ru 'gyur/ /ma yi ma de dgra ru 'byung*/ /g.yon du skor bas bu ru 'gyur/ /bu yi bu de grogs su 'byung*/ /gzhan yang brtsi tshul gcig la ni/ /shing ma chu la chu ma lcags/ /lcags ma sa la sa ma me/ /me yi ma ni shing yin no/ /shing bu me la me bu sa/ /sa bu lcags la lcags bu chu/ /chu yi bu ni shing yin no/ /shing dgra lcags la lcags dgra me/ /me dgra chu la chu dgra sa/ /sa yi dgra ni shing yin no/ /shing grogs sa la sa grogs chu/ /chu grogs me la me grogs lcags/ /lcags kyi grogs ni shing yin te/ /snga ma de dang don gcig 'gyur/ /de ltar ma bu dgra grogs 'thab/ /ma dang phrad na dkar po gsum/ /grogs dang phrad na dkar po gnyis/ /bu dang phrad na dkar nag zung*/ /dgra phrad nag po rnam pa gnyis/ /sa chu nang phrad dkar po re/ /shing lcags me gsum nag po ste/ /bzang ngan 'bras bshad logs su blta/ /de nas spar kha'i skor 'go ni/ /skyes pa li nas khon phyogs dang*/ /bud med kham nas khon phyogs skor/ /lo grangs re la spar kha re/ /spar kha'i zur bzhi bcu tshan re/ /bcu kha ma longs re re brtsi/ /spar kha bzang bzhi ngan bzhi ste/ /brgyad skor dang po bzang bzhi ni/ /me yis chu skol sman du che/ /gnam nas sa ltas sman du che/ /lcags kyi ri skos sman du che/ /rlung gis shing bskyod sman du che/ /gnam sman 'go ba rab kyi rab/

/shing gis me sbar rlung chu rten/ /gnam nas lcags rnyed sa ri btsugs/ /srog 'tsho yin te rab kyi 'bring*/ /rlung gis me bus sa la lcags/ /ri yis gnam snyegs chus shing skyed/ /dpal bskyed pa ni rab kyi tha/ /phywa lon rang gi phyogs nas lon/ /'bring gi rab ste bzang bzhi'o/ /phywa mnyam rang phyogs 'bring gi 'bring*/ /me ri rlung rnams lcags chu dang*/ /shing sa gnod pa 'bring gi tha/ /lcags la me 'bar sa rlung 'tshub/ /gnam la shing skyes rir chu 'bab/ /'dre lnga tha ma'i rab yin no/ /li dang khen 'gras dwa dang zin/ /khon dang kham 'gras gin dang zon/ / bdud gcod tha ma'i 'bring du brjod/ /smyon mas 'jor thogs phas chu bcus/ /ma yis me bus sgom chen shing*/ /'thu ba lus chad tha ma'i tha/ /so so'i kha dmar 'grel bar ltos/ /spar kha'i thog tu lo du lon/ /brtsi na pho mo'i khyad par gyis/ /li dang kham nas steng 'og tu/ /mchongs te gcig bcu bcu gsum dang*/ /nyer lnga so bdun zhe dgu dang*/ /re gcig don gsum gya lnga ru/ /bgrang ste brtsi tshul shes par bya/ /rus sbal yan lag rnam brgyad las/ /nyi zla la sogs gza' brgyad char/ /nyi ma mig dmar me yi khams/ /zla ba lhag pa chu yi khams/ /phur bu shing la spa sangs lcags/ /spen pa sa yi khams nyid de/ /ra hu spyi khyab 'byung lnga tshang*/ /rus sbal tshigs chen nyer brgyad las/ /rgyu skar nyer brgyad chad de yang*/ /min drug sogs bdun shar skar shing*/ /skag sogs bdun ni lho skar me/ /sa ga sogs bdun nub skar lcags/ /mon gre sogs bdun bya skad chu/ /yang na skag dang sa ga dang*/ /byi bzhin bra nye sa skar ro/ /de nas sme ba'i skor 'go ni/ /rang rang skyes sme dbus bzung nas/ /mo lo g.yon la pho lo g.yas/ /skyes sme gang yin dbus bzhag pa'i/ /brgyad kyis bskor ba'i brgyad cu gcig /skor 'go phyi nang gsang gsum las/ /'dir ni lte skor gtso bor bya/

/dbus nas gnam lcags ri bo dang*/ /me chu sa shing lug la gnas/ /rlung nas slar yang dbus su 'jug /sme ba re la bcu tshan re/ /bcu kha ma long re re brtsi/ /gcig bcu bcu dgu nyer brgyad dang*/ /so bdun zhe drug nga lnga dang*/ /re bzhi don gsum gya gnyis dang*/ /go gcig rnams la dbus su tshogs/ /kha dmar 'bras bshad dag tu blta/ /spar kha mi yi pho mo dang*/ /me ba lo yi pho mo'o/ /pho lo dbus nas shar thon te/ /byang shar mtshams phyin shar lho nas/ /dbus su 'gro'o mo lo ni/ /dbus nas shar thon shar lhor 'gro /byang shar nang du 'jug bya ste/ /sngon ma de dang khyad par yod/ /gang du sleb pa babs sme yin/ /bai dkar ltar na 'di lta ste/ /da lta'i rab byung bcu gsum pa/ /sme 'phreng bar pa'i bzhi pa ste/ /yar bzhi bdun dmar srog sme la/ /mar bzhi bzhi ljang dbang thang sme/ /skyes sme gcig dkar klung rta'i sme/ /gnyis nag yin te de yi khungs/ /yar bzhi srog la mar bzhi dbang*/ /gang sems lus sme mthun gsum klung*/ /srog ni phrag pa g.yas la gzar/ /dbang thang rkang pa g.yon pas 'drud/ /lus de lto bar bkab nas 'gro /zhes pa'i dgongs pa yin par bshad/ /dus bzhi'i ngos 'dzin zla ba la/ /mi 'dra yod kyang lugs 'dir ni/ /dgun nyi ldog pa'i zla ba de/ /dpyid zla ra ba stag tu 'dod/ /mgo yis nya na zla bshol med/ /gza' ni spen pa dar bas tshes/ /dbyar nyi ldog pa'i zla ba de/ /ston zla ra ba sprai'ur 'dod/ /snron gyis nya na zla bshol med/ /gza' ni mig dmar dar bas tshes/ /stag rta khyi gsum spen dang tshes/ /khyi 'brug spel gsum mig dmar tshes/ /phag lug yos gsum zla bas tshes/ /bya glang sbrul gsum phur bus tshes/ /gang tshe de dar bu yag dar/ /ma bzhud dgra rgud grogs ni gyod/ /tshes gcig brgyad nya nyi shu gnyis/ /nyi shu bdun nas bdun skor byed/ /'on kyang lhag chad dbang gis ni/ /mi 'drar 'gyur ba yong srid do/

/da lta'i rgya rtsis mchu zla la/ /lo 'go 'dzin 'di hor lugs dang*/ /bstun pas de yang shes par gyi/ /lo 'gros chung ba'i brtsi lugs ni/ /pho ni me stag thur la sbubs/ /mo ni chu sprel gyen du bkan/ /gang la babs pa'i 'grel par blta/ /stag yos 'byor pa yin pas bzang*/ /khyi 'brug gnyis ni gnam sgo la/ /phag sbrul gnyis ni sa sgo yin/ /glang lug gnyis ni phung gyod de/ /bya sprel gnyis ni bye bral la/ /byi rta gnyis ni so thub yin/ /kha dmar gang yin gzhan du shes/ /yang na brtsi bya'i lo khams de'i/ /skyes pa bu 'ded stag thog nas/ /du lon lo grangs thur du 'dren/ /bud med ma yi sprel thog nas/ /du lon lo grangs gyen du bkan/ /gar babs log men nyid du bzhed/ /de yi yar lnga 'jug thag lnga/ /'di dang brtsi bya'i srog 'thab bya/ /mar lnga bgrangs pas rten phur lnga/ /brtsi bya'i lus dang 'thab pa'i gzhi/ /yar gyi brgyad ni gnam rgyang yin/ /de ni dbang thang 'thab pa'i gzhi/ /mar gyi brgyad ni sa rgyang yin/ /brtsi bya'i klung dang 'thab pa'i gzhi/ /bzang ngan 'bras bshad nyid du ltos/ /lo gcig skeg rtsis skor 'go ni/ /bai dkar las ni 'byung ba'i tshul/ /rgyas bshad mang ste mtshon tsam zhig /gnam lo log men sbar kha dang*/ /sme ba dar gud brtsi dus rdel/ /rtsa ba'i rdel drug rim pa ltar/ /brtsi bya'i srog lus dbang rlung bzhis/ /'thab pa'i gcod dral nyer bzhi dang*/ /kha dmar rdel bzhi rtsub rdel bdun/ /sme keg bzhi dang dgu dur gnyis/ /yongs bsdus zhe bdun sogs bshad kyang*/ /mdor na brtsi bya'i srog lus dang*/ / dbang rlung spar sma la sogs pas/ /gnam lo'i srog sogs dang 'thab ste/ /kha dmar 'bras bshad dag tu blta/ /gzhan yang shin tu gnad che ba/ /nad pa sri'u'i ched gsungs pa'i/ /rde'u bcu dgu de dag ni/ /brtsi bya'i srog gis gnam lo yi/ /srog dang 'thab pa'i rde'u gcig

/dar gud sbyar ba'i rde'u gnyis/ /zla ba blon po'i srog 'thab gsum/ /dar gud sbyar ba'i rde'u bzhi/ /zhag po dmag mi'i srog 'thab lnga/ /dar gud zhag steng khyer ba drug /dus tshod mtshon cha'i srog 'thab bdun/ /dar gud khyer ba'i rde'u brgyad/ /de bzhin lo zla zhag dus bzhi'i/ /lus dang 'thab pa'i rde'u bzhi/ /dar gud sngar bzhin khyer ba bzhi/ /brgyad de khyon bsdom bcu drug steng*/ /gza' tshes skar ma'i rdel gsum bcas/ /bcu dgus gtan phab bzang 'jam dkar/ /rtsub na nag por 'bor bshad de/ /kha dmar rgyas par gzhan du shes/ /dar gud sbyor lugs gong brjod ltar/ /dbugs len mngal gnas lus rdzogs sogs/ /bcu gnyis dang sbyar de yang ni/ /srog lus dbang thang klung rta rnams/ /sa chu yin na dbyar ra sbrul/ /me yin dgun zla ra ba phag /lcags yin dpyid ra stag nas bzung*/ /shing rnams ston ra spre'u nas/ /dbugs len bya'o gnam lo'i steng*/ /sleb tshe lo yin zla zhag dus/ /gang gi steng slaib de nyid yin/ /las byed gos gyon khrus byed dang*/ /dar ba btsas pa lus rdzogs drug /bzang zhing gzhan drug ngan par bshad//'bras bshad rgyas par gzhan du blta/ /gzhan yang brtsi bya'i lo khams nyid/ /shes par 'dod na gnam lo nas/ /lo grangs du lon gyen bgrangs pas/ /gar babs brts-i bya'i lo yi khams/ /brtsi bya'i lo nas du lon thur/ /bgrang bas gar babs gnam lor shes/ /de yang rang sor rnam pa lnga/ /shing me sa lcags chur bzhag ste/ /steng 'og pho mo gnyis byas pa'i/ /gnam lo'i khams sbyar du lon yar/ /brtsis pas brtsi bya'i khams lo shes/ /bcu kha ma longs re re brtsi/ /longs na lnga tshan gnyis bsdoms pa'i/ /bcu tshan mchongs tshul shes pa gnad/ /de yang mthong brgyud man ngag las/ /rtogs par 'gyur gyi gzhan du min/ /de ltar 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi/ /man ngag gcig bsdus nag rtsis kyis/ /lde mig lta bu mtshon tsam zhig

/gzhan phan ched dang brjed thor bkod/ / ces pa 'di yang*/ co ne'i khri zur bshad sgrub ming can gyis gzhan re gnyis la phan srid snyam pa'i 'dun pas mkhas pa khyung dang bai dkar gnyis ka nas bshad pa dang bstun te co ne'i dgon nyid du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni tā yi la lung blo bzang don grub bo/ /maṅgalaṃ// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/lo dang spar me'i re'u mig gi skor dang*/ rtsis kyi lde mig gi skor don bsdus bzhugs/ - PAGE 404-- PAGE 403-- PAGE 389 -
